Hotel staff can now ask Oracle's AI for help at the front desk

Oracle (NYSE:ORCL) introduced Oracle OPERA Cloud Assistant, a suite of embedded AI capabilities in OPERA Cloud to streamline hotel operations. Features include AI-driven room assignment, automated rate descriptions, operational Q&A, and multilingual translation, aimed at improving staff productivity
